explanation: Places the actual arithmetic-stage charge in the runtime exponent ledger. The concrete per-triple budget is assigned the arithmetic ledger exponent for each fixed input-magnitude exponent.
theorem_title: Power bound for the per-triple arithmetic budget
theorem_natural_language_statement:
For each fixed magnitude exponent $k\in\mathbb N$, the explicit per-triple budget $A_k(n)$ satisfies $$\operatorname{PowerBound}\!\left(A_k,\frac85\varepsilon(E+\tfrac12)\right).$$ Here $\varepsilon,E$ are the fixed analytic parameters.

Places the actual arithmetic-stage charge in the runtime exponent ledger. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
